answer: Charge identities in dedicated bandwidth they must prove concurrently. Each identity periodically answers a random retrieval beacon by serving its uniquely assigned data shard within a tight deadline; passing demands real egress held open for that identity alone. A fleet behind one timber-framed uplink shares a single pipe, so when many personas are pinged at once they contend and miss deadlines — bandwidth cannot be duplicated across a thousand fakes like a copied key. Breadth then costs a sonnet of simultaneous throughput that physical links cap linearly per head.
